runtimeNotes.movement: The desktop runtime translates and rotates the 100x150 sprite; the APNG sequences interpolate leg and antenna motion for a smoother gait.
runtimeNotes.idle: When it stops, it only uses the calm idle animation until the pointer enters its body.
runtimeNotes.eat: A restrained head-and-antenna dip plays after a confirmed feed; it does not reuse the struggle motion.
runtimeNotes.turn: The roach briefly plants its legs and turns when it reaches the edge of the work area.
